blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the position of the human heart in the chest. Describe the structure and functions of the pericardium. (4 marks)
(Seene mein insani dil ki jagah bayan karein. Pericardium ki banawat aur kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Jagah: dil seene ki cavity ke darmiyan phephron ke beech hai. Is ki pichhli satah reerh ki haddi ke qareeb aur agli satah sternum aur pasliyon ki cartilages ke peeche hai. Phephron ke beech hone ki wajah se baayan phephra chhota hai aur us mein cardiac notch hai.

Pericardium: dil ko gherne wali theli jo use aas paas ke aaza se alag karti hai. Is ki do tehein:
• Fibrous pericardium (bahari): mazboot connective tissue; dil ko bahari dabao aur jhatkon se bachata aur zarurat se zyada phailne se rokta hai.
• Serous pericardium (andaruni): do tehon ki theli, (a) bahari parietal pericardium jo fibrous ke neeche hai aur (b) andaruni visceral pericardium (epicardium) jo dil se chipka hai.

Pericardial cavity: parietal aur visceral pericardium ke darmiyan jagah; is mein 50 mL tak pericardial fluid hai jo dil ko chikna rakhta aur infections se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is composed of the following two layers;

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the four chambers of the human heart and the septa that separate them. (4 marks)
(Insani dil ke chaar chambers aur unhein alag karne wale septa bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Chambers:
• Upar do patli deewar wale atria (daayan aur baayan) jism se khoon le kar ventricles ko dete hain. Daayan atrium superior aur inferior vena cava se deoxygenated khoon leta hai; baayan atrium pulmonary veins se oxygenated khoon leta hai.
• Neeche do moti deewar wale ventricles khoon jism mein bhejte hain. Daayan ventricle pulmonary trunk ko aur baayan ventricle aorta ko khoon pump karta hai. Baayen ventricle ki deewar daayen se taqreeban 3 guna moti hai kyun ke use poore jism mein khoon dhakelna hota hai.

Septa:
• Atrioventricular septum: atria ko ventricles se alag karta hai; tricuspid aur bicuspid valves isi mein ventricles ke dakhli raston par hain.
• Interatrial septum: baayen aur daayen atrium ko alag karta hai.
• Interventricular septum: baayen aur daayen ventricle ko alag karta hai; yeh interatrial septum se bohat mota hai.
Deoxygenated (daayen) aur oxygenated (baayen) khoon mukammal alag rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: There are four chambers of heart

blocks.prompt:
3 What is a cardiac cycle? Describe its phases with their timings and explain how the heart sounds are produced. (4 marks)
(Cardiac cycle kya hai? Is ke phases un ke waqt ke saath bayan karein aur samjhayein ke dil ki awazein kaise paida hoti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Cardiac cycle: dil musalsal cycles mein kaam karta hai; is ke chambers dheele ho kar bari veins se khud ba khud bharte hain, phir sukar kar khoon aage dhakelte hain. Yeh baari baari dheela hona aur sukarna aik cardiac cycle (aik dharkan) hai.

Phases:
1. Diastole (taqreeban 0.4 s): atria aur ventricles dheele hote hain aur dono atria khoon se bharte hain.
2. Atrial systole (taqreeban 0.1 s): dono atria sukar kar tricuspid aur bicuspid valves se khoon dheele ventricles mein bhejte hain.
3. Ventricular systole (taqreeban 0.3 s): bhare ventricles sukar kar khoon pulmonary arteries aur aorta mein pump karte hain; tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band aur pulmonary aur aortic valves khulte hain.
Zindagi bhar dil taqreeban 2.5 billion baar dharakta hai.

Dil ki awazein (stethoscope se):
• 'Lubb': dono ventricles sukarne par tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band hote hain.
• 'Dubb': ventricular systole khatam ho kar ventricles dheele hone par pulmonary aur aortic semilunar valves band hote hain.
Agar valves poore band na hon ya tang khulen to turbulence murmur (sar sar ki awaz) ki shakal mein sunai deti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4 Heart rate changes with the body's needs. (i) Explain how the brain adjusts the heart rate. (ii) Why and how is an artificial pacemaker used? (4 marks)
(Dil ki raftar jism ki zaroorat ke mutabiq badalti hai. (i) Samjhayein ke dimagh dil ki raftar kaise badalta hai. (ii) Masnooi pacemaker kyun aur kaise istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Dil ki raftar: aam baligh ka dil taqreeban 70 baar fi minute dharakta hai aur har minute poora khoon (taqreeban 5 litre) pump karta hai. Normal raftar pacemaker (SA node) aur AV node qaim rakhte hain. Dimagh bhi asar dalta hai:
• bukhar aur warzish mein dimagh ka control centre pacemaker aur AV node dono ko nerve signals bhej kar raftar barhata hai taa ke halat ka muqabla ho;
• neend ya aaraam mein dimagh ka control centre in ki activity dheemi kar deta hai.

(ii) Masnooi pacemaker: agar electrical impulses ka bahao ruk jaye ya SA node ke impulses kamzor hon to dharkan ki tarteeb dheemi ya band ho sakti hai. Aise kamzor SA node wale mareezon mein masnooi pacemaker lagaya jata hai. Yeh battery se chalne wala aala hai jo surgery se jism mein lagta hai; yeh electrical signals de kar normal dharkan chalata hai.

book_ref.quote: The normal speed of heartbeat is made and maintained by pacemaker and AV node.

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the waves, segments and intervals of a normal ECG and the abnormalities each may indicate. (4 marks)
(Normal ECG ki waves, segments aur intervals aur un se zahir hone wali kharabiyan bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
ECG dil ke impulses se banne wale electrical potentials ko record karta hai; dil ke mukhalif taraf skin par electrodes lagte hain jo electrocardiograph se jure hote hain. Is ke hisse:

• P wave: atrial depolarization ki shuruat (SA node se); atria sukarte hain. Be-qaida ya ghayab P waves arrhythmia dikha sakti hain.
• PR interval aur segment: PR segment atrial depolarization ki takmeel dikhata hai. Normal PR interval 0.12-0.20 s hai; 0.20 s se lamba PR interval first-degree heart block hai.
• QRS complex: ventricles ki depolarization ki shuruat; atrial repolarization bhi isi waqt. QRS ki kharabi bundle branch block, ventricular tachycardia ya ventricles ki doosri kharabi dikha sakti hai.
• ST segment: ventricular depolarization ki takmeel, taqreeban 0.08 s; ischemia mein neeche aur myocardial infarction mein upar.
• T wave: ventricles ki repolarization ki shuruat; kharabi electrolyte ki gharbar dikha sakti hai; hyper-acute T wave acute myocardial infarction ki pehli nishani hai.
• QT interval: QRS ki shuruat se T wave ke aakhir tak; normal taqreeban 0.40 s.

book_ref.quote: ECG shows the following waves of electrical impulses

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: book ne 0.12-0.20 second ko PR segment ki muddat likha hai. Asal mein yeh normal PR interval hai (P wave ki shuruat se QRS ki shuruat tak). PR segment is se chhota hota hai. First-degree heart block mein PR interval 0.20 s se lamba hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
6 Some newborns are blue babies. (i) What are blue babies and what causes their condition? (ii) Give reason: the left ventricle has the thickest wall and the heart is felt on the left side. (4 marks)
(Kuch naumolood bachay blue babies hote hain. (i) Blue babies kya hain aur in ki halat ki wajah kya hai? (ii) Wajah batayein: baayen ventricle ki deewar sab se moti hai aur dil baayen taraf mehsoos hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Blue babies: kuch ghair mamooli bachon ki jild neeli (cyanosis) hoti hai. Yeh dono atria ke darmiyan oxygen wale aur baghair oxygen ke khoon ke milne se hota hai, aur jism ko mila jula khoon milta hai. Wajahen:
• interatrial foramen ka nashonuma mein band na hona; yeh embryo ke dil mein daayen aur baayen atrium ke darmiyan aarzi surakh hai jo aam tor par band ho jata hai;
• ductus arteriosus ka poora tang na hona; yeh embryo ki pulmonary artery aur aorta ke darmiyan aarzi raasta hai jo aam tor par band ho jata hai.

(ii) Baayan ventricle aorta ke zariye poore jism (phephron ke siwa) ko khoon pump karta hai, is liye is ki deewar daayen ventricle se taqreeban 3 guna moti hai jo sirf phephron ko pump karta hai. Dil ka baayan hissa zyada taqatwar aur bara hai, is liye dil aam tor par baayen taraf mehsoos hota hai halan ke woh seene ke darmiyan phephron ke beech hai.

book_ref.quote: Some abnormal babies may have blueness (cyanosis) of skin.

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain how capillaries are suited for exchange of materials. How is interstitial fluid formed? (4 marks)
(Samjhayein ke capillaries cheezon ke tabadle ke liye kaise mozoon hain. Interstitial fluid kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Tabadle ki jagah ke tor par capillaries:
• Yeh arterioles ke batne se banti hain, mil kar venules banati hain aur tamam tissues mein cells tak pohanchti hain; koi cell capillary se 100 micrometre se zyada door nahi.
• In ki deewarein endothelial cells ki aik teh hain; andaruni diameter taqreeban 8 micrometre, is liye RBCs aik qatar mein guzarte hain.
• Baligh mein in ki kul lambai 80,600 km se zyada hai, yun tabadle ki bohat bari satah milti hai.
• Khoon aur tissues mein tabadla diffusion ya active transport se hota hai; paani aur ghulne wali cheezein endothelial cells ya un ke darmiyani khalaon se guzarti hain. Kuch cheezein endocytosis se andar aa kar exocytosis se doosri taraf jati hain.

Interstitial fluid: capillaries ke andar ka pressure plasma se fluid musalsal tissues mein rasata hai. Is interstitial fluid mein paani, ghuli ghiza, hormones, gases, fuzlaat aur chhote proteins hain. Bare proteins, RBCs aur platelets capillaries mein rehte hain, magar kuch WBCs darmiyani khalaon se nikal jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Capillaries are the sites where materials are exchanged between blood and body tissues

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain how arterioles change the blood supply of a tissue according to its metabolic activity. (4 marks)
(Samjhayein ke arterioles kisi tissue ki metabolic activity ke mutabiq us ki khoon ki supply kaise badalti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Banawat: arterioles ki deewaron mein elastic tissue se zyada circular muscles hain. In ka sukarna nervous aur endocrine systems ke control mein hai.
• Vasoconstriction: circular muscles sukar kar arterioles ko tang karte aur khoon ka bahao kam karte hain.
• Vasodilation: yeh muscles dheele ho kar arterioles ko chaura karte aur bahao barhate hain.

Metabolic activity ka jawab:
• Tissue ki activity barhne par us ke interstitial fluid mein oxygen kam aur carbon dioxide zyada hoti hai.
• Jawab mein us tissue ki arterioles ke circular muscles dheele hote hain (vasodilation).
• Arterioles aur capillaries mein khoon ka bahao barhta hai, zyada oxygen aati aur zyada carbon dioxide nikalti hai.
• Activity kam hone par arterioles tang (vasoconstriction) ho kar supply kam kar deti hain.
Capillary beds mein capillary loops ke dakhle par pre-capillary sphincters bhi bahao control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Vasoconstriction and vasodilation happen in response to changes in metabolic activity of tissues.

blocks.prompt:
9 Blood moves at different speeds in different vessels. (i) Describe the velocity of blood in different vessels and its cause. (ii) How do veins return blood to the heart at low pressure? (4 marks)
(Khoon mukhtalif vessels mein mukhtalif raftar se chalta hai. (i) Mukhtalif vessels mein khoon ki raftar aur us ki wajah bayan karein. (ii) Veins kam pressure par khoon dil tak kaise wapas lati hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Khoon ki raftar:
• aorta mein sab se zyada, 450-500 mm/sec;
• arteries aur arterioles mein kam hoti hui capillaries mein sab se kam, taqreeban 1 mm/sec;
• venules, veins aur vena cavae mein dobara barh kar 250-300 mm/sec.
Yeh tabdeeliyan vessels ke nizam ke kul cross section ki tabdeeli se hoti hain.

(ii) Veins se wapsi:
• Veins jism se khoon dil ki taraf lati hain; in ki tunica media patli aur thori muscle wali hai kyun ke inhein zyada pressure nahi sehna parta.
• Veins ke semilunar valves khoon ko wapas behne se rokte hain.
• Aas paas ke muscles ka sukarna veins ko dabata aur khoon ki wapsi mein madad deta hai.
• Chhoti veins mil kar bari veins aur aakhir mein superior aur inferior vena cavae banati hain jo daayen atrium mein khoon dalti hain; pulmonary veins baayen atrium mein khulti hain.

book_ref.quote: The velocity of blood flow is different in different vessels.

blocks.prompt:
10 Define a portal system. Describe the hepatic portal system and explain the role of the liver in it. (4 marks)
(Portal system ki definition likhein. Hepatic portal system bayan karein aur is mein jigar ka kirdar samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Portal system: woh circulation jis mein veins capillaries par khatam hoti hain.

Hepatic portal system:
• Bari hepatic portal vein spleen aur alimentary canal se khoon le kar jigar tak le jati hai jahan yeh capillaries mein khatam hoti hai.
• Jigar se khoon hepatic veins ke zariye dil tak jata hai.
• Yeh nizam oesophagus ke nichle hisse se anal canal ke upar wale hisse tak phaila hai.
• Yeh systemic circulation ka hissa hai.

Jigar ka kirdar: alimentary canal se aane wale khoon mein chhoti aant se jazb cheezein hoti hain. Yeh dil jane se pehle jigar se guzarti hain. Jigar khoon se nuqsan deh cheezein nikalta aur ghiza zakheere ke liye jazb karta hai, phir yeh khoon dil ko bhejta hai.

book_ref.quote: The blood that comes from alimentary canal to liver contains substances

blocks.prompt:
11 Compare pulmonary circulation with systemic circulation. (4 marks)
(Pulmonary circulation ka systemic circulation se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Insanon (aur tamam mammals aur birds) mein khoon do bare raston mein chalta hai. Dil double pump hai: daayan hissa pulmonary aur baayan hissa systemic circulation chalata hai. Muqabla table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: blood circulates throughout body in two main pathways

rows: Phephron ke siwa tamam cells, tissues aur aaza tak aur wapas
Daayen ventricle se: pulmonary trunk daayen aur baayen pulmonary arteries mein batt'ta hai
Baayen ventricle se: aorta khoon jism ko le jati hai
Arteries deoxygenated khoon le jati hain; lung capillaries mein khoon oxygen leta hai
Arteries oxygenated khoon le jati hain; tissues ko oxygen milti hai
Pulmonary venules mil kar pulmonary veins banati hain jo baayen atrium mein khulti hain
Veins mil kar vena cavae banati hain jo daayen atrium mein khulti hain
Dil ka daayan hissa chalata hai
Dil ka baayan hissa chalata hai; coronary, hepatic portal aur renal circulations shamil

blocks.prompt:
12 Explain how the hormones ADH and ANH act in opposite ways to keep blood volume and blood pressure normal. (4 marks)
(Samjhayein ke ADH aur ANH hormones mukhalif tareeqe se khoon ka hajm aur blood pressure kaise normal rakhte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Blood pressure ka lamba control hormones karte hain jo gurdon mein paani aur namak ke dobara jazb hone par asar daal kar khoon ka hajm badalte hain.

ADH (antidiuretic hormone), jab hajm aur pressure kam hon:
• Khoon ke hajm aur pressure ki kami dimagh ke khaas receptors mehsoos karte hain; yeh pyaas paida karte hain.
• Yeh posterior pituitary gland ko ADH kharij karne par ubharte hain.
• ADH gurdon se zyada paani khoon mein roakwata hai aur peshab mein kam nikalta hai, yun hajm aur pressure bahaal hote hain.
• ADH arterioles ko tang bhi karta hai jis se arterial pressure barhta hai.

ANH (atrial natriuretic hormone), jab hajm barhe:
• Khoon ka hajm barh kar daayan atrium khinche to us ki deewar ke endocrine cells ANH kharij karte hain.
• ANH peshab se namak aur paani ka ikhraj tez kar ke khoon ka hajm aur pressure kam karta hai.

Yun ADH hajm aur pressure barhata aur ANH ghatata hai, aur dono mil kar inhein normal rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: The long-term regulation of blood pressure is done through hormones.

blocks.prompt:
13 What is coronary angiography? Describe how it is performed and how it is linked to treatment. (4 marks)
(Coronary angiography kya hai? Bayan karein ke yeh kaise ki jati hai aur ilaj se is ka kya taluq hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Cardiovascular mareezon mein ECG aur angiography jaise tests asal masla dhoondte aur bimari ki shiddat naapte hain.

Coronary angiography: dil ki blood vessels ya chambers ka X-ray muayna.
• Doctor aik chhota nali jaisa aala, catheter, jism ki bari arteries se guzarta hai.
• Jab catheter ki noke coronary arteries ke munh tak pohanchti hai to catheter mein khaas fluid (contrast medium ya dye) dala jata hai.
• Yeh fluid X-ray machine mein nazar aata hai aur coronary artery mein fluid ki tasweerein (angiograms) li jati hain.
• Agar coronary artery ke lumen mein clots hon to artery tang nazar aati hai.

Ilaj se taluq: diagnostic catheter ko guiding catheter se badal kar doctor is ke zariye coronary artery mein aalaat bhej sakte hain; sab se aam guide wires aur balloon dilation catheters hain jo angioplasty mein istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Coronary angiography is an X-ray examination of blood vessels or chambers of heart.

blocks.prompt:
14 Define hypertension. Describe its harmful effects on the brain, heart and kidneys. (4 marks)
(Hypertension ki definition likhein. Dimagh, dil aur gurdon par is ke nuqsanat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hypertension: blood pressure ka lamba (chronic) izafa, jab yeh musalsal 140/90 se upar rahe.

Nuqsanat:
• Blood vessels aur dimagh: musalsal zyada pressure se vessels phatne ka khatra barhta hai. Dimagh mein aisa ho to brain haemorrhage hai jo dimagh ki nazuk banawat ko nuqsan deta hai.
• Dil: hypertension dil ke muscles ko kamzor karta hai. Lamba ho to dil theek pump nahi kar pata aur tissues ki zaroorat poori nahi hoti; khoon dil aur phephron mein ruk sakta hai. Yeh congestive heart failure hai.
• Gurde: hypertension nephrons ko nuqsan de sakta hai. Is se khoon mein namak aur paani mazeed rukta hai aur hypertension aur barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Whenever blood pressure is chronically elevated

blocks.prompt:
15 What is thrombosis? Describe its causes and its effects on the heart and brain. (4 marks)
(Thrombosis kya hai? Is ki wajahen aur dil aur dimagh par is ke asraat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Thrombosis: thrombus ka banna, yani blood vessel mein khoon ke ajza ka thos lothra (clot) jo vessel ko poora ya kuch band kar sakta hai.

Wajahen:
1. blood vessels ki andaruni tah ki irritation ya infection;
2. lambi be-harkati se khoon ke bahao ka kam hona;
3. pneumonia, tuberculosis aur emphysema jaisi bimariyan.
Atherosclerosis bhi arteries ko tang kar ke thrombus ka khatra barhata hai.

Asraat:
• Thrombosis aaza tak khoon ka bahao rokta hai.
• Coronary arteries mein thrombus heart attack paida karta hai.
• Dimagh ki vessels mein thrombus stroke paida karta hai.
• Thrombus apni jagah se hat kar doosri jagah ja sakta hai; tab use embolus kehte hain. Thrombus banna aur doosri jagah pohanchna thromboembolism hai.

book_ref.quote: Thrombosis blocks the blood flow to organs.

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the functions of the lymphatic system, including the roles of lymph nodes, lymphoid masses and spleen. (4 marks)
(Lymphatic system ke kaam bayan karein, jin mein lymph nodes, lymphoid masses aur spleen ka kirdar shamil ho.)
blocks.explanation:
Lymphatic system (lymph vessels, lymphoid masses, lymph nodes aur lymph) cheezein le jata aur tissues se wapas khoon mein lata hai.

1. Fluid ki wapsi: izafi fluid, ghule proteins aur doosri cheezein khoon mein wapas lata hai. Aam insan mein roz taqreeban teen litre izafi fluid blood capillaries se nikalta hai; lymph capillaries ise jazb kar ke dil mein dakhil hone se pehle khoon mein wapas la deti hain.
2. Charbi ka jazb: lacteals (villi ki lymph capillaries) jazb shuda fatty acids aur glycerol se bane chylomicrons leti hain.
3. Difa: lymph nodes lymph saaf karte hain; un ke lymphocytes aur macrophages lymph ke bacteria aur viruses khatam karte hain.
4. Lymphocytes banana: lymphoid masses (alimentary canal ki mucosa aur submucosa mein; bare masses spleen, thymus, tonsils aur adenoids) lymphocytes banate hain.
5. Spleen: apne macrophages aur lymphocytes se khoon saaf karta hai jo bairooni zarrat aur purane RBCs khatam karte hain; yeh RBCs jama bhi karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Lymphatic system also helps to defend body against foreign invaders.

blocks.prompt:
17 Lymph capillaries also absorb fat. (i) What are lacteals and how do chylomicrons reach them? (ii) Describe lymph nodes and explain why they swell in diseases such as mumps. (4 marks)
(Lymph capillaries charbi bhi jazb karti hain. (i) Lacteals kya hain aur chylomicrons un tak kaise pohanchte hain? (ii) Lymph nodes bayan karein aur samjhayein ke mumps jaisi bimariyon mein yeh kyun soojhte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Lacteals: villi mein lymph capillaries ki shakhein.
• Fatty acids aur glycerol villi ke epithelial cells mein jazb ho kar triglycerides banate hain.
• Triglycerides par proteins chadh kar chylomicrons bante hain jo lacteals mein dakhil hote hain.
• Lymph capillaries blood capillaries se zyada permeable hain, is liye aise bare molecules in mein ja sakte hain.

(ii) Lymph nodes: kuch jaghon par lymph vessels mein connective tissue ke dher hote hain jin mein lymphocytes hain; yeh lymph nodes hain.
• Kayi afferent lymph vessels node mein aati hain aur aik efferent lymph vessel lymph bahar le jati hai.
• Yeh gardan, bagal (axilla) aur groin mein hote hain.
• Yeh lymph saaf karte hain; un ke lymphocytes aur macrophages bacteria aur viruses khatam karte hain.
• Soojan: mumps jaisi bimariyon mein lymph nodes ki dard bhari soojan zyada tar murda lymphocytes aur macrophages ke jama hone ka nateeja hai.

book_ref.quote: The branches of lymph capillaries in villi, are called lacteals.
